stops.stop: Rome, October 1922
stops.date_confidence: Attested, but the usual citation is wrong. The source is Dominik Jost, Ludwig Derleth: Gestalt und Leistung (Stuttgart, 1965), p. 103, quoted verbatim in Georg Doerr: 'Im Oktober 1922, waehrend des Aufenthaltes in Ascona, reiste Ludwig Derleth mit Olga Froebe nach Rom.' The juxtaposition with the March on Rome of 28-30 October 1922 is this file's, not a source's: no reaction by Derleth to the March, then or later, is recorded anywhere reached.
